detailed_description: The Video to Base64 tool converts a selected video file to a Base64 string in the browser with the FileReader API. You can choose or drag and drop a video file up to 10 MB, preview the selected video, see the original file size and Base64 output size, include or remove the data URI prefix, and copy the generated output. It is best suited for quick tests with small video files rather than production video delivery.
usage_steps: Choose a video file or drag and drop it into the upload area.
Wait while the browser reads the file and generates the Base64 output.
Preview the selected video and check the displayed file size information.
Use the data URI checkbox to include or remove the prefix, then copy the Base64 output.
usage_examples: Convert a small MP4 clip to a data URI for a quick HTML prototype.
Copy a short test video as Base64 for trying an API payload format.
Compare the original file size with the larger Base64 text output before deciding whether to use it.
Remove the data URI prefix when only the raw Base64 text is needed.
